The socks feature horizontal stripes in variegated yarns of pink, red, grey, and white. The texture is highly detailed, showing individual loops of the knit/crochet stitch. The socks cover the feet and extend up the lower calf. The background is a light-colored tiled floor with some faint blue lines or debris.
